title: The termwise product of two etale hypercovers is a hypercover
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $U_\bullet\to X$ and $V_\bullet\to X$ be augmented simplicial objects in the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $X$ (augmented simplicial $X$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] with all terms etale over $X$) whose degree-$n$ maps $U_n\to M_n(U)$, $V_n\to M_n(V)$ to their matching schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] are etale coverings (surjective etale morphisms) for every $n\geq0$. Let $W_\bullet$ be the augmented simplicial object with degree-$n$ term the fibre product $W_n=U_n\times_XV_n$ [def-pc-fibre-product], face and degeneracy maps the induced morphisms $d_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}d_i$, $s_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}s_i$, and augmentation the structure morphism $W_0\to X$. Then $W_\bullet$ is an augmented simplicial object of the small etale site of $X$ whose maps $W_n\to M_n(W)$ are etale coverings for every $n\geq0$ (an etale hypercover of $X$), and the two termwise projections $W_\bullet\to U_\bullet$, $W_\bullet\to V_\bullet$ are morphisms of augmented simplicial $X$-schemes.

source.place: Lemma 01GI (lemma-product-hypercoverings), statement and proof; the covering-pullback argument is Lemma 01GH (lemma-funny-gamma)

proof.text: *$W_\bullet$ is an augmented simplicial object of $X_{\Et}$ and the projections are morphisms.* Each $U_n\to X$, $V_n\to X$ is an object of $X_{\Et}$, and fibre products in $X_{\Et}$ exist and are the scheme-theoretic ones [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; so $W_n=U_n\times_XV_n$, with its structure morphism to $X$, is an object of $X_{\Et}$, and the induced morphisms $d_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}d_i$, $s_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}s_i$ are morphisms of $X_{\Et}$. Every simplicial identity (for instance $d_id_j=d_{j-1}d_i$ for $i<j$, and the identities involving the augmentation $\varepsilon:W_0\to X$, $\varepsilon d_0=\varepsilon d_1$) is an equality of two morphisms into a fibre product $W_k=U_k\times_XV_k$ (or into $X$); after composing with the projections $p_k$, $q_k$ it becomes the same identity in $U_\bullet$ and in $V_\bullet$, which hold, so it holds in $W_\bullet$ by the uniqueness clause of the universal property of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. The defining equations $p_{k}\circ(d_i\times d_i)=d_i\circ p_{k+1}$, $q_k\circ(d_i\times d_i)=d_i\circ q_{k+1}$ (and the same for $s_i$ and the augmentations) say exactly that $p=(p_n)_n:W_\bullet\to U_\bullet$ and $q=(q_n)_n:W_\bullet\to V_\bullet$ are morphisms of augmented simplicial $X$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover].

source.place: Section 01GG (section-covering), first paragraph: the category of simplicial objects of SR(C,X) has fibre products (Simplicial, Lemma 016U, lemma-fibre-product), computed termwise; Lemma 01GI (lemma-product-hypercoverings), proof: 'verify this directly'

proof.text: *The matching map of $W$.* Fix $n\geq0$. By [lem-weil-pbc-matching-object-fibre-product], applied to $U_\bullet$, $V_\bullet$ and $W_\bullet$ of step 1, the morphism $M_n(W)\to M_n(U)\times_XM_n(V)$ induced by $p$ and $q$ is an isomorphism, and it carries the matching map $\mu_n^W:W_n\to M_n(W)$ to the induced morphism $\mu_n^U\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\mu_n^V:U_n\times_XV_n\to M_n(U)\times_XM_n(V)$. (For $n=0$: $M_0=X$, $X\times_XX=X$, and $\mu_0^W$ is the augmentation of $W$.) Since a composite of a surjective etale morphism with an isomorphism is surjective etale, it suffices to show that $\mu_n^U\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\mu_n^V$ is surjective and etale.

source.place: Lemma 01GH (lemma-funny-gamma), proof, second paragraph: 'The functor cosk_n sk_n commutes with fibre products ... Thus the right hand side above is equal to A x_B C' (Simplicial, Lemma 018D)

proof.text: *Factorization into two base changes.* Write $A=M_n(U)$, $C=M_n(V)$, $\alpha=\mu_n^U:U_n\to A$, $\gamma=\mu_n^V:V_n\to C$, all over $X$. Then $\alpha\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\gamma=b\circ a$ with $a=\alpha\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\mathrm{id}_{V_n}:U_n\times_XV_n\to A\times_XV_n$ and $b=\mathrm{id}_A\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\gamma:A\times_XV_n\to A\times_XC$; both sides agree after the two projections, so they agree by [def-pc-fibre-product]. The square with top $a$, left the projection $U_n\times_XV_n\to U_n$, right the projection $\mathrm{pr}_A:A\times_XV_n\to A$ and bottom $\alpha$ is cartesian: given $u:T\to U_n$ and $(a',v):T\to A\times_XV_n$ with $\alpha u=a'$, the morphism $(u,v):T\to U_n\times_XV_n$ (defined since $U_n\to X$ is $A\to X$ composed with $\alpha$) is the unique one with both composites as given, again by the universal property of [def-pc-fibre-product]. So $a$ is the base change of $\alpha$ along $\mathrm{pr}_A$, i.e. $U_n\times_XV_n\cong U_n\times_A(A\times_XV_n)$ with $a$ the second projection. Since $\alpha$ is surjective etale (an etale covering of $A$ with one member), [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change] applied to the family $(\alpha)$ and $g=\mathrm{pr}_A$ shows that $a$ is etale and surjective. In the same way $b$ is the base change of $\gamma$ along the projection $A\times_XC\to C$ (the square $A\times_XV_n\to V_n$, $A\times_XC\to C$ is cartesian by the same argument with the roles of the factors exchanged), so $b$ is etale and surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change].

source.place: Lemma 01GH (lemma-funny-gamma), proof, second paragraph: 'K_{n+1} x_B C -> A x_B C is a base change of the covering K_{n+1} -> A ... is a covering as a base change of a covering' (Lemma 01G4, lemma-covering-permanence), specialized to L = the constant object X as in Lemma 01GI (lemma-product-hypercoverings), proof

proof.text: *Conclusion.* By step 3, $a$ and $b$ are surjective etale, so $b\circ a=\mu_n^U\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\mu_n^V$ is surjective etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-composition] (one-member families). By step 2, $\mu_n^W:W_n\to M_n(W)$ is an etale covering for every $n\geq0$; together with step 1 this is the statement, the projections $p,q$ being the morphisms of hypercovers to $U_\bullet$ and $V_\bullet$.
